T: Back undercover, this time with a bigger budget for snacks.
D: Schmidt and Jenko go undercover at college to find who is supplying a new drug.
P: Serve the crab when the crab people gag kicks in.
S: Panko crumbed crab cakes with lemon and chipotle mayo

Golden crab cakes bound with mayonnaise, spring onion and lemon, pan-fried crisp and served with smoky chipotle mayonnaise and lime. Mix 400g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 2 sliced spring onions, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tsp Dijon and 60g panko crumbs. Shape into 12 small cakes and chill 30 minutes. Roll in 60g more panko. Fry in 3 tbsp oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and a squeeze of lime. Serve the cakes with the mayo and lime wedges.
Crisp baked wings tossed in sticky barbecue sauce

Crisp baked wings glazed in a sticky honey barbecue sauce with soy and smoked paprika, scattered with sesame and spring onion. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp cider vinegar for 3 minutes until sticky. Toss the hot wings in the glaze and return to the oven for 5 minutes. Scatter with 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.
M: Lager-battered flathead, slaw, chipotle crema in warm tortillas

Crisp beer-battered flathead in warm tortillas with lime slaw, pickled red onion, chipotle crema and fresh coriander. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold lager to a batter. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tsp chipotle sauce. Fill 12 warm tortillas with slaw, fish, crema, onion and coriander.
W: Dining hall skillet choc chip cookie
Giant chocolate chip cookie baked in a skillet

One giant choc chip cookie baked in a cast iron pan until gooey in the middle, topped with vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce. Melt 125g butter and beat in 150g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 200g plain flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb, a pinch of salt and 150g chocolate chips. Press into a greased 25cm ovenproof frying pan. Bake at 180C for 18 to 20 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the centre. Rest 5 minutes, then top with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and drizzle with chocolate sauce. Serve with 4 spoons.
K: Frozen mango, tequila, orange liqueur and lime with a salted rim

Tequila, fresh lime and frozen mango blended icy smooth with a splash of orange liqueur, poured into salt-rimmed glasses. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 glasses and dip in sea salt flakes. Blend 400g frozen mango, 160ml tequila, 60ml orange liqueur, the juice of 4 limes, 2 tbsp sugar syrup and 2 cups of ice until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses and garnish with lime wheels. For an alcohol-free version, swap the tequila and liqueur for 200ml orange juice.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix, shape and chill the cakes up to 1 day ahead, covered; crumb and fry on the night and mix the chipotle mayo up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Mix the crab with some of the mayonnaise, egg, spring onions, lemon zest, mustard and half the panko.
Shape into small cakes and chill.
Roll the cakes in the remaining panko.
Fry in oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.

veg.n: My name is Jeff hearts of palm cakes
veg.make_ahead: Mix and chill the hearts of palm cakes up to 1 day ahead, covered; finish with the panko and fry on the night

steps.text: Drain the hearts of palm, pat dry and shred with a fork. Mix with 3 tablespoons of the mayonnaise, the egg, spring onions, lemon zest, mustard, the crumbled nori and half the panko.
Shape into small cakes and chill.
Roll the cakes in the remaining panko.
Fry in the oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Mix the remaining mayonnaise with the chipotle and a squeeze of lime. Serve with lime wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Toss the wings in the baking powder mix up to 1 day ahead and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry; bake and glaze on the night

steps.text: Toss the wings with the baking powder, paprika and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey, soy and vinegar until sticky.
Toss the hot wings in the glaze and return to the oven.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.

veg.n: Frat house sticky barbecue tofu wings
veg.make_ahead: Press and tear the tofu up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; make the glaze up to 3 days ahead. Bake and glaze on the night.

steps.text: Wrap the tofu in a clean tea towel and press it under a heavy pan for 15 minutes, then tear it into 4 cm chunks.
Toss the tofu with the cornflour, paprika, olive oil and salt until every piece is coated.
Spread the tofu on two lined trays and bake at 220C for 30 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey, soy and cider vinegar for 5 minutes until sticky.
Toss the hot tofu in the glaze and return to the oven for 5 minutes to caramelise.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and spring onions.

Pat the banana blossom dry and pull into bite-sized pieces. Crumble the nori.
